```{r}
# Load 
load("../data/df _IBs_1_zscore_processing_speed_final.Rdata")
```


```{r}
# Run the mediation (significant after FDR correction): 
library(mediation)

# 1) Fit the mediator model 
model_M <- lm(ICAM1 ~ s_psy_abus_CAT + age + sex + bmi + SES + phys_act + depression,
  data = df_IBs_1_zscore_processing_speed_final
)

# 2) Fit the outcome model (Executive Func) 
model_Y <- lm(cf_zscore_processing_speed ~ s_psy_abus_CAT + ICAM1 + age + sex + bmi + SES + phys_act + depression,
  data = df_IBs_1_zscore_processing_speed_final
)

# 3) Run the mediation 
# Using min/max of stressor as control/treat
min_val <- min(df_IBs_1_zscore_processing_speed_final$s_psy_abus_CAT, na.rm=TRUE)
max_val <- max(df_IBs_1_zscore_processing_speed_final$s_psy_abus_CAT, na.rm=TRUE)

med_out <- mediate(
  model.m  = model_M,
  model.y  = model_Y,
  treat  = "s_psy_abus_CAT",
  mediator = "ICAM1",
  robustSE = TRUE,
  sims = 1000,
  control.value = min_val,
  treat.value = max_val
)

med_sum <- summary(med_out)
med_sum


# 4) Bootstrap‐based sensitivity analysis 
sens_out <- medsens(med_out,
  effect.type  = "indirect", # ACME
  rho.by  = 0.05
)

# 6) Extract the critical sensitivity values 
sens_tab <- summary(sens_out)

rho_star <- sens_tab[["Rho"]]  # ρ at which CI crosses 0
R2_med <- sens_tab[["R^2_M~R^2_Y~"]]  # R2_med (at ρ*)
R2_out <- sens_tab[["R^2_M*R^2_Y*"]] # R2_out (at ρ*)

cat("\n Sensitivity Analysis Results: \n",
    "Critical ρ  (ACME CI to 0):", rho_star, "\n",
    "R2 (mediator) at ρ*  :", R2_med,  "\n",
    "R2 (outcome)  at ρ*  :", R2_out,  "\n"
)



```
